title: Medical Records Release Checklist
subtitle: Define the records, recipient, date range, delivery, expiration, revocation, and disclosure trail.
description: Records the patient and signing authority, releasing custodian, named recipient and endpoint, purpose, record categories, From and Through dates, exclusions, secure delivery, expiration, revocation, and receipt.
use_case: Use when a patient or authorized representative directs a records custodian to disclose a bounded set of records. Route legal or privacy questions to the authorized records or privacy reviewer.

sections.title: Medical Records Release starting details
sections.guidance: Identify patient and representative authority, recipient and secure endpoint, record categories, date range, purpose, exclusions, expiration, revocation, and disclosure proof. Record the medical records release decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

blocks.label: Medical Records Release people and reference

sections.title: Medical Records Release checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current medical records release facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Medical Records Release required checks
items: Record category is identified for this record
Date range matches the current request or source
Purpose is ready for point-of-use staff
Recipient limits or questions are resolved
Secure delivery is communicated to the responsible person
Disclosure log is confirmed at handoff

blocks.label: Medical Records Release failed or pending items

sections.title: Medical Records Release readiness
sections.guidance: Hold medical records release readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Medical Records Release reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Medical Records Release receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
